rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail baseline with the strongest nearby missed idea: cap the earlier recurrent-tail block at evaluation and late training instead of forcing all recurrence gains to 1.0. This keeps the deep reverse-tail path active while softening the shallower repeated block, which is consistent with the close miss from the capped recurrence profile and costs almost no bytes or runtime.
title: Capped Staged Reverse-Tail Eval Profile
